moduleDoc:
Tessera concentrated-liquidity AMM (issue #361).

This contract replaces the previous constant-product pool with a Uniswap
v3-style tick-indexed model adapted to Soroban storage:

- Each initialised tick is a `PersistentStorage` entry keyed by its `i32`
  tick index, holding gross and net liquidity.
- A position is a liquidity range `[tick_lower, tick_upper)`. When a
  position-NFT contract is configured, `add_liquidity` mints one NFT per
  position through a cross-contract call to `mint_position`.
- `swap` walks initialised ticks in the direction of the trade, crossing
  each one, and takes a `max_ticks_crossed` bound. Exceeding it reverts the
  whole swap instead of silently returning a worse price.
- Within any single tick range the virtual reserves satisfy
  `x * y = L^2`, so the constant-product invariant holds while the price
  stays in that range (see [`math`]).

Fees are charged in the input token on every step and accumulated in
Q64.64 per unit of liquidity, so positions collect pro-rata via
`collect_fees`.

methods.name: initialize
methods.doc: Configure the pool. `initial_tick` must be a multiple of `tick_spacing`; the opening sqrt price is derived from it.

methods.name: set_position_nft
methods.doc: Set the position-NFT contract. Positions are minted there as NFTs on every `add_liquidity` call.

methods.name: add_liquidity
methods.doc: Add liquidity to `[tick_lower, tick_upper)` and mint a position.  Only the amounts actually required at the current price are pulled from `to`; any remainder stays in their wallet. Returns the position id and the liquidity minted.

methods.name: remove_liquidity
methods.doc: Burn `liquidity` from a position and return both tokens to its owner. Fees accrued so far are paid in the same call.

methods.name: collect_fees
methods.doc: Withdraw accrued fees without touching the liquidity.

methods.name: swap
methods.doc: Swap along the tick curve.  `amount_specified > 0` is the exact input amount; a negative value requests that much output. `sqrt_price_limit` bounds the price the trade may reach; `max_ticks_crossed` bounds how many initialised ticks the loop may cross before the call reverts with `TooManyTicksCrossed`.

methods.name: position_amounts
methods.doc: The tick range a position with `liquidity` covers at the current price.
